description: Looks up one landmark, museum or other place in Audiala's audio-guide catalog and returns a place card: a photo, a short summary, a 45-second preview of the narrated audio guide that the user can play in the card, and a link that opens the full guide in the Audiala app. Use this when the user asks for Audiala's audio guide to a specific named place, or asks to hear it. Both the city and the place name are required. Only the 45-second preview plays in the chat; the full narration is in the Audiala app. If the place has no guide, the result lists up to 6 places in that city that do (kind "place_candidates"). Read-only.

city.description: City the place is in, as a name or catalog slug, for example 'Rome' or 'rome'.

lang.description: Language of the guide and its preview. Defaults to en.

monument.description: Name of the landmark, museum or place, for example 'Colosseum'.

name: get_audio_guide_preview

app_url.description: Opens the city in the signed-in Audiala web app.

guides_count.description: Number of audio guides in the city.

listen_in_app.description: Deep link to the full guide in the Audiala app.

message.description: Why nothing matched and what to try instead.

suggestions.description: Other places in the city that have a guide, when the place was not found.

url.description: Public audiala.com page for the place.

title: Get audio guide preview
